# Memos feed and CRUD reduction

This fixture retains the login, feed, pagination, creation, editing, deletion,
reaction, realtime refresh, reconnect, route cleanup, and logout roles from Memos at
`e5ed6e7ec60e141d6e354f3ab59906c2c47dccac` (MIT). A deterministic server owns
the durable records while ordinary React-shaped state, effects, forms, and
keyed rows compile through existing Kudzu semantics.
